data.name: Mahesh Gurjal
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Mahesh Gurjal has made a big mark in cricket. With 187 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 63*, with an average of 22.57 and a quick strike rate of 142.87. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 186 sixes and 167 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 120.5 overs, taking 34 wickets at an economy rate of 8.61. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
